title: Silent Failure Modes in GDELT-Based Crisis Research: replication materials
description:
Replication materials for a methods paper documenting twenty-three measured defects in GDELT as a research instrument, and for a companion findings paper on narrative crisis detection across six Nigerian cases, 2014-2024.

Contains: the retrieval and analysis package; a provenance database of 4,943 logged retrievals (endpoint, parameters, response SHA-256, outcome); pre-registration documents for all three rounds; case specification files; re-executable boundary probes with a recorded run; and the thirteen-step validation protocol as a runnable checker.

Raw GDELT records are deliberately excluded. The provenance database records the exact request behind every figure so that each can be re-executed against GDELT directly.
